name: Casa Pestagua
insider_take: This stunning colonial mansion turned luxury boutique hotel sits in the heart of Cartagena's UNESCO World Heritage old town, where centuries of Caribbean history whisper through its elegant courtyards.
whats_special: Casa Pestagua occupies a meticulously restored 17th-century colonial house that once belonged to a wealthy merchant family. The hotel showcases original architectural details like hand-carved wooden balconies, coral stone walls, and traditional Spanish tiles, all while offering modern luxury amenities. Its rooftop terrace provides breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and the city's iconic fortified walls.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cocktail on the rooftop terrace during golden hour – the views of Las Murallas (the ancient city walls) and the Caribbean beyond are absolutely magical and perfect for Instagram-worthy shots.
dont_miss: Take a evening stroll along the nearby Plaza de los Coches and Plaza de la Aduana, just steps from the hotel. The surrounding cobblestone streets come alive with street performers, local artists, and the intoxicating sounds of vallenato music echoing from colonial balconies draped in vibrant bougainvillea.
pros: Historic colonial mansion with authentic architectural details
Prime location in Cartagena's Old Town UNESCO World Heritage site
Relais & Châteaux luxury standards and personalized service
Intimate boutique atmosphere with carefully curated interiors
cons: Limited room inventory due to boutique size
Historic building constraints may limit modern amenities
